summary: Jeremiah prophesies the destruction of the people—For this he is arraigned, tried, and then acquitted.
meta_description: Jeremiah prophesies the destruction of the people—For this he is arraigned, tried, and then acquitted.

footnotes.note3_a: HEB relent; i.e., change the decreed punishment because of their changed behavior.
footnotes.note6_c: JST Jer. 26:6 … earth; for ye have not hearkened unto my servants the prophets.
footnotes.note13_a: JST Jer. 26:13 … and repent, and the Lord will turn away the evil …
footnotes.note19_a: JST Jer. 26:19 … and beseech the Lord and repent? and the Lord turned away the evil which he had pronounced against them. Thus by putting Jeremiah to death we might procure great evil against our souls.
